title: Target Elements with Class and ID Selectors
task: Style HTML elements using CSS class and ID selectors. In your HTML, create an element with `id="banner"` and another element with `class="highlight"`. In your CSS, style `#banner` with `color: #2563eb` and style `.highlight` with `font-size: 20px`.
hints: In your HTML, give one element `id="banner"` and another element `class="highlight"`.
In your CSS, use `#banner` to select the ID and set `color: #2563eb`.
Use `.highlight` to select the class and set `font-size: 20px`.

rules.message: HTML must contain an element with id='banner'.
The banner element must have id='banner'.
HTML must contain an element with class='highlight'.
